# Studiolo

> Studiolo is a free, open-source (MIT) focus timer that paints a one-of-a-kind generative artwork while you work. It runs as a web app (installable PWA, works offline) and as a Windows desktop app built with Tauri. There is no account and no tracking; all data stays on the user's device.

Key facts:
- Timer modes: Pomodoro (focus, short and long breaks), countdown, stopwatch. Tasks with estimates, activities with colors, stats, streaks and achievements.
- Seven art styles (Flow Field, Harmonograph, Nebula, Topography, Aurora, Stained Glass, Visualizer). Each session is seeded; the piece completes as the session does and is saved to a local gallery.
- Desktop extras (Windows): a floating always-on-top mini timer, music-reactive art from system audio, now playing, tray mode, in-app updates, and an optional read-only local data API on 127.0.0.1:47800.
- In Chrome and Edge, the web app can pop out the mini timer using Picture-in-Picture.

## Use it

- [Web app](https://jadonjahn.github.io/studiolo/): runs in any modern browser
- [Windows installer](https://github.com/jadonJahn/studiolo/releases/latest): `Studiolo_<version>_x64-setup.exe`; unsigned, so SmartScreen asks once ("More info → Run anyway")
